scripts.vercel:env:prod:trip-website: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue; [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue; [[ "$line" == *=* ]] || continue; name="${line%%=*}"; value="${line#*=}"; [ -z "$value" ] && continue; printf %s "$value" | vercel env add "$name" production --scope ayabongaqwabis-projects --cwd apps/trip_website --force --yes >/dev/null; done < apps/trip_website/.env.local'
